is now worth hundreds of billions more than $META.

@aleabitoreddit Always behind ! never a leader $aapl no innovation just a bunch of followers
@aleabitoreddit Serenity, I want a clear and short answer, will the market return to its good old days anytime soon?

John Ternus is a lot proactive than Tim Cook, so we'll see how he does. 

Apparently he's the one that pressured $AAPL software team to accelerate Apple's AI roadmap.

Especially since Apple is currently using $GOOGL cloud (Nvidia/TPUs) for their own bottlenecks + other LLMs like Gemini for Siri. 

I don't think Apple is comfortable being dependent on third parties for something that should be in-house.

I don't know how markets perform short term. Anyone who claims they can give you a clear answer is BSing. 

But, especially since tech is getting sold off from record develeraging + degrossing... short interest is record highs on many names... and we're now seeing a bubble in staples from AI L/S pods being blown up. 

It can snap back faster than people think from a catalyst. 

That being said out of any investment theme from biotech, space, physical AI, cybersecurity: I still believe photonics is the most compelling opportunity.  

+ that many other names in AI have been sold off way beyond what fundamentals suggest.

I'm hearing multiple things from industry executives:

1. Potential $NVDA employee exodus if Jensen doesn't come back soon.

Many senior management and engineers can easily retire after Nvidia stock appreciation over the years.

They don't need to continue working sitting on millions in equity. But they continued to work because Jensen was a visionary leader.

Under new interim CFO (former CFO), it gives an excuse for that lot of people to finally quit soon. A pay bump or hiring $ARM CEO isn't going to change that.

So you have generational talent leaving.

2. Loss of confidence in $NVDA future growth (Jensen was the moat).

What I'm hearing is that Jensen understands heavily top-down architectures, and it's this magical discretionary element that doesn't get covered in media.

When cuda, network, and $NVDA internal teams are arguing, Jensen made the final choices around heavily nuanced discretionary decision about where Nvidia + AI ecosystem ends up going:

Then everyone followed. The supply chain, capital, agreements, and faith.

You also can't suddenly replace the trust that local Taiwanese factories build with Jensen over the years if you bring in external CEOs, or even internal executives.

It was transformational bet after bet after bet after bet that Jensen made until Nvidia became a former $5T+ company.

3. $NVDA is not that technologically far ahead of others. It's not a 5 year lead, but months ahead to a year in different areas.

Jensen was accelerating all of that. Longer Jensen is gone, the longer Nvidia and its competitive ecosystem decays, beyond the current near-term roadmaps.

Nvidia's greatest moat was Jensen Huang making high-stake architectural decisions and accelerating capital, suppliers, + the industry to rally around his vision.

There's a massive loss of confidence in $NVDA with Jensen gone.

Heads up, we’re starting to test dots with a small number of ChatGPT Plus users. Looking forward to the continued feedback as we expand and I’m recently seeing a lot more positives around how good the proactivity has been after many improvements. 

We’re also bringing dots to all ChatGPT Business Standard users. Rollout will start today.

We’re also working on a new mobile experience for ChatGPT! 

It’s easier to get to your favorite features and discover what you can do in ChatGPT. We’re starting with Pro users who have a dot or are eligible to create one. Your dot gets its own tab, and you can pin Codex, Projects, Images, and more to the tab bar. Some of you will see the new experience by default. 

You can turn it on or off anytime in Settings > New ChatGPT Design. 

Super excited to hear your feedback before we roll it out more widely!
